review.title: OpenClaw Marketing Skills Collection
review.summary: This skill bundles 37 ready‑to‑use marketing sub‑skills for OpenClaw agents, covering CRO, copywriting, SEO, paid ads, analytics, growth, sales, and data connectors. It provides a quick index and natural‑language triggers, plus optional integration with the TweetClaw plugin for X/Twitter actions. While the catalog is comprehensive, it lacks detailed prerequisites, input/output specifications, and verification steps for each sub‑skill.
strengths: Integration with real‑data connectors (Google Ads, Search Console, Meta Ads, X/Twitter)
weaknesses: Missing explicit prerequisites for each sub‑skill
No detailed input/output definitions or step‑by‑step workflow
Relies on external skill folders not included in the document
Limited guidance on verification of results
Safety guidance on credential handling is minimal
recommended_improvements: Add a prerequisite section describing required OpenClaw configuration and any external API keys
For each listed skill, include a concise input schema, expected output, and verification checklist
Provide example prompts and expected responses for at least a few representative skills
Expand safety guidance: how to store credentials securely, rate‑limit API calls, and comply with platform terms
Include a brief maintenance note on updating connector credentials and plugin versions
